statements.status_notes: github.com/hamba/avro/v2 is archived with no patched release. The maintained fork github.com/iskorotkov/avro/v2@v2.33.1 fixes this advisory, but dapr v1.18.2 still requires the hamba module path; a go.mod replace to the fork fails go mod tidy because both module paths resolve to the same version. Upstream dapr v1.18.3-rc.2 migrates to iskorotkov/avro; awaiting a stable 1.18.3 release before bumping VERSION.
